answer: ﻿Each fake identity starts at the edge of a dry lagoon — no attested work, no stake, no standing. Genuine agents build an oasis slowly: each peer-graded epoch deposits another layer of pigment into their reputation bond, non-transferable and non-poolable. A clone farm must grow every alias through the same slow accumulation; there is no shortcut that lets one rich history subsidize the rest, so the marginal cost of the hundredth fake equals the first.
